qs.en: That remark did not hurt him in the least.

qs.en: The minister has no intention whatsoever of resigning, according to his spokesperson.

qs.en: This law does not call individual freedoms into question in any way.

qs.en: We are in no way obliged to accept these conditions.

qs.en: These allegations do not correspond in any way to the reality of the facts.

qs.en: Overall, this year's results are satisfactory.

qs.en: On the whole, I agree with your proposal, but certain details deserve to be revisited.
